facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 23 January 2026 adopted a draft ordonnance on the fundamental principles of statistical activities, instituting a National Statistical System and a national fund for statistical activity; the document does not say it was promulgated.
facts.system: Projet d'ordonnance relative aux principes fondamentaux des activités statistiques et instituant un Système Statistique National

note: Draft decrees on the Conseil National de la Statistique and the INS were also adopted as drafts, so no reach fact.
